scope: Exact patch application verification only; no new content review, hypotheses, proof, translation or chapter edits. Compare all six XVIII/XIX files to paused958 baseline plus the29 recommendations, with reference-2 correctly applied.

diagnosed_report_defect.cause: Reviewer selected the first identical Chinese citation match in the shared paragraph instead of the intended second occurrence. Consequently target_after duplicated reference-1; the generated application_group also failed to remove the second link. Original uniqueness and in-memory applicability checks were insufficient to detect this semantic occurrence mismatch.
diagnosed_report_defect.responsibility: Defect originated in this reviewer’s original evidence report, not in the Chinese translation or the root application.

B^{0}_{j}$ 诱导。此外，各 $W_{j}$ 之间的 $U$-态射
由各 $A$-代数 $B_{j}$ 之间的态射诱导，从而
由各 $B^{0}_{j}$ 之间的态射诱导

立即可见，它是 $U^{0}$ 的一个超覆盖。

method: Retrieve each full chapter from git958, verify its SHA256 against the adjudication input, reconstruct all29 exact emendations in memory with corrected reference-2 target_after, merge disjoint edits sharing a paragraph, and compare the full expected UTF8 bytes with the current file. No whitespace normalization or mathematical-token normalization.
limitations: This verifies exact implementation of the already adjudicated recommendations; it does not repeat source adjudication or full paragraph review.
Prior original-editor caveats and unavailable-original-scan limitations remain as recorded.
